purpose: Turn a short owner prompt containing subject/grade/topic/questions into a governed QRT authoring work order without asking the owner for fields the system is designed to derive.

clarification_policy.ask_owner_only_when: The missing value cannot be established from repository/source evidence and materially changes provenance, personalization, or product role.

owner_questions.prompt: What does the learner already know for this topic? Give idea-level DEMONSTRATED / UNCERTAIN / MISSING states, or explicitly choose USE_DEFAULT_GENERIC.
owner_questions.why: Learner-specific X/Y support cannot honestly claim a demonstrated bridge without learner evidence.

owner_questions.prompt: Are these questions OWNER_SUPPLIED, AUTHORED_PRACTICE, copied from an EXTERNAL_SOURCE, or ADAPTED from a source?
owner_questions.why: Core role and source-custody claims depend on provenance.

owner_questions.when: provenance.kind is EXTERNAL_SOURCE or ADAPTED and provenance.source_note is absent
owner_questions.prompt: What is the source/locator? If unknown, answer UNKNOWN and the agent must research source custody.
owner_questions.why: The system must not invent exam/textbook identity or source custody.

owner_questions.prompt: Should these be preserved as owner/source questions (PRESERVE_OWNER_QUESTIONS) or treated as authored practice (AUTHORED_PRACTICE)?
owner_questions.why: PRESERVE_OWNER_QUESTIONS routes to Core2; AUTHORED_PRACTICE routes to Core2A.

never_ask_owner_for: difficulty band or five difficulty components

role_routing.rule: Preserve supplied wording/custody. OWNER_SUPPLIED carries no invented exam identity; external/adapted material requires custody research before source claims.
Treat the learner questions/support as AUTHORED_PRACTICE inside taught canonical capability.

output_contract.html_rule: Use governed Core2/Core2A rendering. Do not substitute a hand-built unrelated HTML page when render_core can render the role.
output_contract.evidence_rule: Bind QRT evidence to question/profile/matrix/adapter/render digests where available.
